{{Quote|I was in that place, Jedi&mdash;if you're looking for President Galthe, I know where they got him.|Voro Hesh|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Voro Hesh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] citizen who was detained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] when [[executive order 228]] was issued. He was liberated from the [[Imperial Holding Facility]] by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and [[Zenith]].
